Tamil Nadu CM to Consult MPs on Delimitation Bill Amid Political Row

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay has called a consultation with the state's Members of Parliament on August 9 regarding the Centre's delimitation proposal. The DMK has announced a boycott of the meeting, calling it a "political drama." The AIADMK has questioned the Chief Minister's urgency on the matter. Meanwhile, Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to visit the South amidst the delimitation row.
